recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: open firmware quietly rooting under codename Ominous Olive
Ubuntu's stingray release surfacing in October
Istanbul streets submerged after rain not seen in eighty-four years
clear autumn night over San Francisco at twelve degrees
October sunset already past, bay fog gathering offshore

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Graft open-source firmware branches onto a motherboard tree before a power surge fries unconnected chips — each tap roots a new node into the circuit.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap nodes to link compatible branches
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one fully rooted tree boots with a satisfying phosphor glow
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: incompatible chip types appear and surge timers shrink each wave
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: phosphor green terminal on matte black PCB

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Ride pulse currents through underwater cable lanes as a stingray release propagates — swipe between lanes to catch packet beats before the stream times out.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: swipe left/right to change lanes on the beat
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: combo chains feel like dependencies resolving in sequence
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: packet storms narrow lanes and beats drift off-tempo
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe stingray in deep blue cable ocean

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick sandbags into breach points on a miniature Istanbul street grid before rainwater from the heaviest storm in decades floods the last dry block.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: flick sandbags toward glowing breach markers
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: the final sandbag sealing a corner triggers a dry-zone cheer
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: rainfall intensity rises and new cracks open mid-round
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout isometric rooftops with ink-wash rain

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Memorize constellation patterns revealed through clearing bay fog on an autumn San Francisco night — tap matching tile pairs before the fog rolls back in.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: tap pairs of tiles when fog briefly clears
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: a perfect recall sweep opens the whole sky for one beat
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: fog thickens faster and overlapping patterns share tiles
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor twilight gradient over silhouetted hills
